name: AK16DH-CO - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, CO, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared & Electrochemical Sensors
highlights: The AK16D-CO on Higher-Class Sensors — Same nine parameters including electrochemical CO, same 24 mm panel. CO₂ moves to infrared NDIR and formaldehyde to an electrochemical cell — three of the four gas channels now on the higher sensor class.
Built for Rooms With Combustion — A gas kitchen produces CO, CO₂ and particulates simultaneously. This configuration measures all three by the methods least likely to be confused by the others.
AQI Plus Nine Readings — Index for the occupant, values for the technician.
The Accuracy Choice in the -CO Family — Where the CO figure may be quoted to an insurer, a landlord or a safety officer, sensor class is the first question asked.
2000 mAh, Six Hours, 249 g — 30 pcs per carton.
